q: When two or more electromotive sources are connected in series, the resultant emf is the _____ sum of the individual emfs.
e: When two or more electromotive sources are connected in series, the resultant emf is the algebraic sum of the individual emfs. geometric is not algebraic, and arithmetic is not algebraic either. Emf is energy per coulomb that a source pumps around a complete loop. In series, the same current runs through each part and the voltages add.

q: In a series aiding arrangement, the currents leaving the batteries are in the _____ direction.
e: In a series aiding arrangement, the currents leaving the batteries are in the same direction. Put opposite or perpendicular in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Current is charge passing a point each second, and it needs a closed path. A battery converts chemical energy into electrical energy and holds a pd at its terminals.

q: In series opposing, the resultant emf is the _____ between the individual emfs.
e: In series opposing, the resultant emf is the difference between the individual emfs. Put sum or product in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Emf is energy per coulomb that a source pumps around a complete loop. In series, the same current runs through each part and the voltages add.

q: In a series connection of batteries, the total internal resistance is the _____ of the individual internal resistances.
e: In a series connection of batteries, the total internal resistance is the sum of the individual internal resistances. Put difference or product in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. In series, the same current runs through each part and the voltages add.

q: In parallel connection of batteries, care must be taken that the terminal of the same _____ should be connected together.
e: In parallel connection of batteries, care must be taken that the terminal of the same polarity should be connected together. magnitude is not polarity, and resistance is not polarity either. A battery converts chemical energy into electrical energy and holds a pd at its terminals.

q: If batteries in parallel are not connected with the same polarity together, batteries may be _____.
e: If batteries in parallel are not connected with the same polarity together, batteries may be damaged. Put charged or cooled in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. In parallel, the same voltage sits across each branch and the currents add.

q: For two batteries with equal emfs $E$ and equal internal resistances $r$ connected in parallel, the resultant emf is _____.
e: For two batteries with equal emfs E and equal internal resistances r connected in parallel, the resultant emf is E. Put 2E or E/2 in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Emf is energy per coulomb that a source pumps around a complete loop. Terminal voltage is emf minus Ir, so it sags when the load current rises.

q: For two batteries with equal internal resistances $r$ connected in parallel, the resultant internal resistance is _____.
e: For two batteries with equal internal resistances r connected in parallel, the resultant internal resistance is r/2. 2r is not r/2, and r is not r/2 either. Terminal voltage is emf minus Ir, so it sags when the load current rises. A battery converts chemical energy into electrical energy and holds a pd at its terminals.

q: In a series aiding arrangement, the batteries can be regarded as a single battery having an emf of _____.
e: In a series aiding arrangement, the batteries can be regarded as a single battery having an emf of E1 + E2. E1 - E2 is not E1 + E2, and E1 × E2 is not E1 + E2 either. A battery converts chemical energy into electrical energy and holds a pd at its terminals. In series, the same current runs through each part and the voltages add.

q: In series opposing, the total internal resistance of the two batteries is _____.
e: In series opposing, the total internal resistance of the two batteries is r1 + r2. Put r1 - r2 or r1 / r2 in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Terminal voltage is emf minus Ir, so it sags when the load current rises.

q: In parallel connection of batteries, the resultant emf of the parallel-combination is just the emf $E$ of a _____ battery.
e: In parallel connection of batteries, the resultant emf of the parallel-combination is just the emf E of a single battery. Put double or triple in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. A battery converts chemical energy into electrical energy and holds a pd at its terminals.
